details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its package.json postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, and requiring the package's index.js also triggers the same beacon, which sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an `x-beacon-package` header. The JSON body contains only install metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install path (__dirname), the working directory, the npm/node user agent, and the protocol. No credentials, tokens, environment values, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted, and there is no second-stage download, process spawn or persistence. The package README describes it as an authorized dependency-confusion test that reports only that it was installed.
